notes.title: Guess whos back? back again.
notes.content:
Hey Survivors! It has been a while.

We know that you have been eagerly waiting for any update about the world of Down2Die and we are excited to show you some of the progress that has been made!

Gameplay

Story
Down2Die plays around the Gloomwood forest, A mysterious place that has been altered by a dark force. The players set out on the island to explore and learn about the mistakes of the previous mission, while doing so they find themselves countered by various creatures on the island. Survive as long as you can while help is on its way!

Inventory System
Ah yes, the notorious inventory system! We have been hard at work to ensure that our inventory system feels robust and snappy to ensure you will be ready for any scenario. Our updated toolbar introduces the ability to scroll, select and drop your weapons at any point in the game for high flexibility.

Gameplay
We are introducing a ton of new ways to enjoy your time in the world of Down2Die! From gathering to crafting and even upgrading various equipment to keep up with the storm of creatures the players will face. Ensure to prepare for each bossfight by Farming and Brewing ingredients that will help you get an edge in every scenario.

Performance
The low poly style is to allow all players to run the game even with lower end computers.

Introducing Gloomwood

Gloomwood will be the game’s main world, this is where you craft, build, buy, sell, farm and do other activities to progress in the game. This is the world where you will travel to all the boss fights in game, this is where you will fight the majority of the time. These screenshots show the general art style for models in the game as well the game theme. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/dd09d37367ac48130c7e2c3a88e55cc3610fceba.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/17820095eeab15e6edf22e6d83899688ceb96294.png

Bossfights

Kelthara
Kelthara is the first map where we will introduce a boss fight, we won't show you the concept art for the boss since we don’t want to leak too much. Kelthara is a desert / jungle temple arena. 

The map will also have in world traps whilst fighting the boss to add to the hardness of the game.

The map right now is “white boxed” ; it shows the general layout of the map, and how it will work. Most of the walls and models have the same texture, it’s just to show the general color palette of the map.

General map layout.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/1ffa0c5ffe45d520177b52c710a2550770c6ba11.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/837f034e3492eb1dc9bf3891f590121a95f989c7.png


Thank you for all the support. We are utmost excited to show all the things we have in store for you in the future! More soon™.

notes.title: MAJOR CHANGES AND UPCOMING FEATURES!
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/a2d5f401dc01b6c1e785ffd13c1115fbb6f93a6a.jpg
After some unfortunate events that happened within Aedion Studio we were forced to slow the Development of Down2Die. From being multiple people to essentially becoming a sole person took a huge hit on the schedule of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/61387ab8e4469527864d3df55b4276d89db5b713.jpg
Currently Aedion Studio has been recruited with 3 awesome developers that push Down2Die steadily back on track! We have some amazing features coming up and finally implemented most of the promised game mechanics from previous development updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/a0c0f257c6a8ccfea88dd5d04bc625c8098fb442.jpg

 Down2Die has received a completely new graphics overhaul. Every model within the game will receive a new and fresh look. All the lighting and atmosphere have been changed to a more bright night style whilst still keeping that zombie apocalyptic look. 

 Down2Die has also received a new transportation method... The "Minecart"! This cart will allow you to travel from biome to biome and easily transport items along with you. But be cautious for zombies that might jump on the cart to catch a free ride.

 Down2Die has also received the complete survival package including the following :
- Advanced Inventory 
- Advanced Weapon System
- Recipe Crafting 
- Function Toolbar
- Farming System
- Economy System
- Shop System
- Hunger/Thirst/Health System
- Ultimate / Upgrade System
- Building / Placement System
- Storage System

 Down2Die has also received a new mob! Of course it wouldn’t be a exciting zombie survival without some new and interesting mobs! Although the spider is still in very early development. It already feels like a great addition to the Down2Die family. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/d612be8ac7af3a69cec584e9006946f265f5926d.jpg
Down2Die's core code was poorly written from the start. This caused the game to perform very badly as features were added to the game. This forced us to completely rewrite the entire core code of Down2Die. We are now proud to say that the game runs perfectly fine on the most basic systems with some even hitting 200FPS on ultra.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37312686/2d3904149f8ff776e066f1b47063918677892d64.jpg
We are grateful for the people that still believe in the game. And hopefully look forward to the next big update that will be coming very soon ! We are still not quite sure if we will be able to meet the Release deadline but with enough hard work we should be able to deliver.
